This geometric, structured display evokes a futuristic and immersive atmosphere, like navigating a data matrix or a virtual reality environment.

presets.name: Ondras - Death Star's Main Gun
presets.description: This music visualizer preset presents a stark, high-contrast aesthetic, dominated by a luminous white double-lined spiral that unfurls against a deep black void. A vibrant red glowing orb pulses at the spiral's tight core, suggesting an energetic nucleus, while subtle dark green streaks and a lone blue vertical line add faint, scattered accents. The overall mood evokes a sense of cosmic mystery and digital elegance, like traversing a minimalist wormhole or observing a distant, glowing celestial body.

Streaky, ethereal blue and bright white beams surge outwards to the left, while arcing trails of segmented white and warm yellow-orange lines sweep across the right against a deep black backdrop. The dominant electric blues, bright whites, and vibrant yellow-oranges evoke a futuristic, intense, and energetic atmosphere. It conjures imagery of a high-tech laser light show, a radar scanning the cosmos, or an abstract representation of sound waves bursting forth in a digital realm.
